basis: GPI-anchor disorder with ID/seizures and ichthyosis; coloboma 8/8. Cap omits hearing loss 8/8, cardiac defects 30-79%, and dental anomalies 80-99%.

decisions.ocular: involved: retinal coloboma in 8/8; retained as the fourth axis after the three-primary cap.
decisions.dermatologic: primary: persistent ichthyosiform dermatosis is a defining feature, present in 8/8.

basis: Cutaneous angioedema with inherited complement-regulatory deficiency. Bowel/airway edema is episodic; isolated neuropathy reports do not establish common nerve damage.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: C1-inhibitor deficiency is an inherited complement-regulatory immune defect; bradykinin mediates the swelling.

basis: B-cell maturation defect and severe dermatitis; developmental impairment 30-79%. Cap omits craniosynostosis, cleft palate, choanal stenosis and eyelid defects, each 30-79%.

decisions.haematologic: primary: defective B-cell maturation with reduced B-cell count in 80-99% directly affects blood cells.
decisions.neurologic: involved: microcephaly and developmental delay occur in 30-79%; retained after the three-primary cap.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none at cap: craniosynostosis occurs in 30-79%, but immune/blood-cell disease, severe dermatitis and neurodevelopmental impairment take priority.

basis: Lymphoid malignancy arising in thyroid. Airway obstruction and dysphagia reflect compression; common intrinsic airway or gastrointestinal damage is not established.

decisions.pulmonary: none: obstruction is annotated 30-79%, but compression-related symptoms do not establish direct airway infiltration or lasting injury.

basis: Solitary cutaneous mast-cell proliferation: skin location and hematopoietic-cell neoplasm. Systemic or marrow involvement is not required or implied.

decisions.haematologic: primary: mastocytoma is a proliferation of hematopoietic mast cells; localization to skin does not remove the cell-lineage axis.

basis: FANCA-related marrow failure; congenital skeletal/radial-ray defects occur in roughly 30-50%. Renal anomalies are about 20-30%; pigmentation alone is not damaging.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: congenital skeletal/radial-ray malformations affect roughly 30-50%; they are associated structural manifestations rather than the defining marrow disease.

basis: Most testicular sex cord-stromal tumors arise from hormone-producing/regulating Leydig or Sertoli cells; fibromatous subtypes are a minority. Hormone excess is not required.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: the predominant Leydig/Sertoli subtypes arise from the gonadal endocrine compartment, even when clinically nonfunctioning.

basis: Angular blepharoconjunctivitis is characteristically bacterial, classically Moraxella-associated, affecting conjunctiva and eyelid canthi.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: this characteristic angular conjunctival/lid infection is classically caused by Moraxella, with other bacterial causes possible.

basis: Endocrine dysfunction/central DI occurs in ~50-70% of classic HPE; oral clefts and hearing loss are each 30-79%. Hypotelorism is non-damaging; lung disease is a secondary complication.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: involved: hypothalamic dysfunction causing central diabetes insipidus affects roughly 50-70% of classic HPE; semilobar disease is within this group.

basis: Molar-root abnormalities and taurodontism are consistent defining findings. Glaucoma, hypotrichosis and digital anomalies are variable, without an established frequency of at least 30%.

decisions.ocular: none: the definition describes glaucoma only in some relatives; it is not required for diagnosis and its frequency is not established at 30% or more.
